title: Vancouver direct from Brisbane - Air Canada?
body:
O.P.
Hi guys, heading to Vancouver next year for some Alaska adventures and would like to fly direct from Brisbane. I think the only airline that does that is Air Canada and I've flown on them before and they've been .... pretty awful. Will be flying Business Class, but looking at reviews, that doesn't seem to improve their service much.
Any recommendations for another airline (even with a stopover) that will make the journey more pleasant?
Thanks in advance.

Zeddog writes...
Any recommendations for another airline (even with a stopover) that will make the journey more pleasant?
I just did Sydney – Vancouver and return with ANA because they had a great fare, certainly way better than Qantas and Air Canada, plus I don't have the aversion to stop-over travel that others do.
I did have to transfer terminals at Haneda on the way out, but this was pretty easy. On the way back I can't recall if I was chasing cheaper fares or if I just preferred the times (for multiple reasons I despise early morning arrivals and will always prefer a day flight), but I did self transfer from Narita to Haneda and then stay in the Haneda terminal hotel so I could get the day flight to Sydney. No complaints about ANA service, or getting a quick stopover in on the way home.
heading to Vancouver next year for some Alaska adventures
I'll bite ... if you're looking for Alaska adventures why are you flying to Vancouver?
I get that getting to Anchorage is a bit tricky but you are probably better off transiting via the US.
